mapper.insert: insert into ai_agent_session_message_event (message_id, event_seq, event_type, payload, create_time) values (#{messageId}, #{eventSeq}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, message_id, event_seq, event_type, payload, create_time from ai_agent_session_message_event where message_id = #{messageId} order by event_seq asc
select max(event_seq) from ai_agent_session_message_event where message_id = #{messageId}
